turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m a 48-year-old woman, and about four weeks ago I noticed a mass in my left breast that has rapidly increased in size. I don’t have any skin or nipple changes, and it isn’t painful.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any small raised bumps or any central dimpling on the skin over the area. I also haven’t seen any skin or nipple changes.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed needing to urinate more often than usual. Patient: The only issue I’ve had is the rapidly enlarging mass in my left breast over the past four weeks.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling a general sense of weakness or a lack of energy throughout your body lately?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t felt unusually weak or run down, and my energy level hasn’t seemed noticeably different. The main thing I’m concerned about is the rapidly enlarging mass in my left breast over the last four weeks.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having any trouble getting dressed or putting on your clothes lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble getting dressed or putting on my clothes, and I don’t feel unusually weak. The only concern I’m having is that the left breast mass has been rapidly increasing in size over the last four weeks.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms. I haven’t had any other skin issues—my only concern is the rapidly enlarging mass in my left breast over the past four weeks.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any itchiness or any new rash or skin irritation. The only change I’ve observed is the rapidly enlarging mass in my left breast over the past four weeks.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calf muscles while walking that feels better once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any calf pain or cramping when I walk, and stopping to rest doesn’t seem relevant. My main concern still is the rapidly enlarging mass in my left breast over the past four weeks.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any change in my stool color—nothing unusually pale or clay-colored.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any weakness in my hands—my grip and ability to open jars seem normal. My only concern is still the rapidly enlarging mass in my left breast over the past four weeks.

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I don’t have any shaking episodes, and I haven’t lost consciousness—I’m only concerned about the rapidly enlarging mass in my left breast over the past four weeks.

turns.doctor_question: Are you currently experiencing any pain or discomfort in your abdominal area?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any pain or discomfort in my abdominal area. I’ve mainly just noticed the rapidly enlarging mass in my left breast over the past four weeks.”
